requirements.location: Complete research selection, report sections1–8, four author units and source-work paragraph.
requirements.basis: Read the full task and complete outline. The purposive candidate selection includes new design, repositioning, repurposing, prospective screening and stopped/inconclusive outcomes, retaining small molecules as the common domain. Candidate–indication–formulation, aliases, dated milestones and cutoff availability govern the dossiers. The proposed mechanism traces computational contributions into laboratory feedback and distinguishes retrospective scores, prospective assays and clinical outcomes. Clinical population/comparator/endpoint conditions and aggregate-denominator problems are assigned. Partnerships cover experimental decision rights, data/IP, handoffs and payment categories rather than headline ceilings. All requested dated evidence chains, stage-aware comparisons and decision implications are represented. Gaps are actual source-recovery work and are not filled from company labels. This is an outline requirements assessment only.
